Class ControllerLessons

java.lang.Object
guiLessons.ControllerLessons
public class ControllerLessons extends Object

Title: ControllerLessons Class.

Description: The Java/FX-based Lessons Learned page. This class provides the controller actions based on the user's use of the JavaFX GUI widgets defined by the View class. Every action passes the typed values to LessonManager, which validates them and uses the Database class, and then shows the result or the error message on the page. No validation rules are written here, so the GUI and the automated tests use exactly the same code. The data that must persist between one user action and the next (the lessons currently shown in the list, and which lesson, if any, is selected) is kept in ModelLessons, not here, so this package follows the same Model/View/Controller structure as the rest of the Foundations GUI packages. The class has been written assuming that the View is the only class that invokes these methods. This is why each has been declared as "protected". Do not change any of these methods to public.
